main_text.head: CAP. X.
De obedientia Christian. in Dioclet. Et Maxim. sub Persequutione aecima.
main_text.p: Persequutionū fluctibus in hoc san-guinis pelago prætereuectis nouem (paucis diebus Halcionijs intercalan-tibus) iam tandem sub Diocletiano & Maximiano Decumanus nobis obuoluitur, iuxta illud Poeticum, non tamen poeticè usurpatum:

p.i: Qui venit hic fluctus fluctus super eminet omnes

main_text.p: „ [Nemo huius Belluae immanitatem potest pro merito describere (inquit g Lib.§.Ca. II [?]{g} Lactantius) qui uno loco recubans, tamen per totum orbem dentibus seuit; & non tantum artus hominum dissipat: sed & offa ipsa comminuit, & in cineres furit, ne quis extet sepul-turæ locus; Quænam illa feritas? quæ rabies? quæ insania? lucem viuis, terram mortuis denegasse.] Fuit hæc per-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "aecima" in the title line [?] (the letter may be d); "venit" in the verse line is hard to read in the italic, so it stands as printed. The verse line is printed with underlining under "Qui venit". The left narrow column is blank. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The quotation's line-initial „ marks are printed on every line; they are given once here. The marginal note reads "g Li.§.Ca." with "II" below; "Li" and the section sign are doubtful. The mark "g" in the text is the section sign before "Lactantius" and is rendered as {g}. "Quænam" is doubtful because the ligature is unclear.
